newsitem.title: USA: NBA BASKETBALL-CAVALIERS EXERCISE OPTION TO USE SUNS' TOP DRAFT PICK.
newsitem.headline: NBA BASKETBALL-CAVALIERS EXERCISE OPTION TO USE SUNS' TOP DRAFT PICK.

text.p: The Cleveland Cavaliers on Monday decided to exercise their option and use the Phoenix Suns' first-round draft pick, 16th overall, acquired as part of a trade prior to the 1995-96 season.
Cleveland gained the first-round choice, to be used either this year or in 1998, in the deal that sent Dan Majerle to Cleveland for John "Hot Rod" Williams.
Cleveland, the final team eliminated from this season's playoff race, also has the 13th choice overall in the June 25 draft to be held in Charlotte, North Carolina.

Phoenix still may have a first-round pick. The Milwaukee Bucks, who have the 10th overall choice, must decide by June 8 if they will send it to the Suns as part of the deal that sent Elliot Perry to Milwaukee. The Suns will receive Milwaukee's first-round pick in 1997, 1998 or 1999.
